out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following hot holding equipment: Cres Cor warmer cabinet (behind carry out register).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS instructed CFM to place ambient temperature inside the Cres Cor warmer cabinet.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Multiple metal pans were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization on shelf above chlorine dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CDI: CFM separated metal containers in shelf to allow to properly dry before stacking.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored over RTE diced tomatoes and containers of refried beans inside of Avantico 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to the top shelf inside Avantico preptop refrigerator and relocated RTE diced tomatoes and refried beans to the bottom shelf inside the Avantico 2 Dr preptop refrigerator. ANITA'S NEW MEXICAN STYLE FOOD (Inspection Date: 12/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: uncooked marinaded chicken and steak stored directly over uncooked pork sausage patties and RTE ground Italian sausage inside of 4 drawer under-grill refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CFM relocated uncooked marinaded chicken and steak to the bottom shelf inside the 4 drawer under-grill refrigerator.

violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS instructed CFM to place ambient temperature in all cold and hot holding equipment (TCS food products storage).

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed multiple metal pans stacked while wet in shelf near chlorine sanitizer dish machine after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CDI: CFM unstacked metal pans to allow for air drying.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: Observed no certified food manager on duty at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. EHS COMMUNICATED THAT A CFM SHALL BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed some hand sinks being used for the storage of equipment, wet towel buckets, or for dumping.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS COMMUNICATED THAT HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING PURPOSES ONLY. ENSURE STAFF ARE RE-TRAINED AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the chemical sanitizing dish machine failing to deliver chlorine at the required 50-200ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS COMMUNICATED TO MANAGEMENT THAT STAFF SHALL BE CHECKING THE LEVEL OF SANITIZER IN THE 5 GALLON BUCKET, PRIMING THE UNIT AS NEEDED, AND TESTING THE RESIDUAL WATER ON THE EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS USING THE PROPER TEST STRIPS BEFORE USE. EHS WAS ABLE TO CHANGE OUT THE CHEMICAL AND PRIME THE UNIT TO ENSURE SANITIZER WAS DELIVERED EFFECTIVELY. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) WHIPPED CREAM STORED IN THE BEVERAGE AIR 1DOOR UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATOR AT THE BAR: 48F, 2) FOOD STORED IN THE 4DRAWER REFRIGERATOR UNDER THE MAIN COOK LINE GRILL: A) CHICKEN TAQUITOS: 45F, B) SMOKED SAUSAGE LINKS: 45F C) PRE-COOKED/SHREDDED BEEF: 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE THE FOODS TO ANOTHER WORKING REFRIGERATOR TO ENSURE THEY DROP BACK DOWN TO 41F OR BELOW AS RAPIDLY AS POSSIBLE. STAFF SHALL BE USING A CALIBRATED, CLEANED/SANITIZED FOOD THERMOMETER TO CHECK FOOD TEMPERATURES EVERY 3 HOURS TO ENSURE PROPER COLD HOLDING. ANITA'S NEW MEXICAN STYLE FOOD (Inspection Date: 07/02/2025) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: 1) FRIED EGGS, 2) 1 OR 2 EGGS, 3) STEAK (ANY KIND FOR FAJITAS, NY STRIP, ETC)
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH THE OWNER THAT TECHNICALLY THE ASTERISK SHALL BE PLACED NEXT TO THE ACTUAL INGREDIENT IN THE MENU ITEM THAT IS ALLOWED TO BE UNDERCOOKED BY THE CONSUMER. EHS ALSO INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO ADD ASTERISKS NEXT TO THE ACTUAL INGREDIENT IN THE MENU ITEM WHERE MISSING. OWNER WILL SEND A DRAFT OF ALL MENUS TO THE EHS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP BEFORE PRINTING THE MENUS TO ENSURE ACCURACY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL ANY CHEMICALS IN SPRAY BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following hot holding equipment: 1) CRES COR HOT HOLDING UNIT AT CARRY OUT, 2) HALO HEAT HOT HOLDING UNIT AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS COMMUNICATED TO STAFF THAT THE HOT HOLDING UNITS SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH WORKING THERMOMETERS DESIGNED TO MEASURE THE AMBIENT AIR TEMPERATURE INSIDE THE HOT UNITS TO ENSURE THEY REMAIN AROUND 165F TO ENSURE FOODS IN THE UNITS STAY AT 135F OR ABOVE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed boxes of tortillas stored in direct contact with the floor in the stairwell leading to the basement storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE DUNNAGE RACKS OR SHELVING UNITS TO ENSURE FOOD IS STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. ANITA'S NEW MEXICAN STYLE FOOD (Inspection Date: 07/02/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO MAKE MORE BLEACH WATER SOLUTION SANITIZER BUCKETS FOR STORAGE OF WET TOWELS. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. ANITA'S NEW MEXICAN STYLE FOOD (Inspection Date: 07/02/2025) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows:1) IN-USE UTENSILS AT THE MAIN COOK LINE STEAM TABLE STORED IN WATER MEASURING 110F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CHANGE OUT THE UTENSILS AND ENSURE THE WATER REMAINS AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed equipment stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS DISCUSSED WET NESTING WITH MANAGEMENT STAFF. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF THAT ALL CLEANED AND SANITIZED EQUIPMENT SHALL BE AIR DRIED BEFORE STACKING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean ice bucket on top of the ice machine was observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH MANAGEMENT THAT ALL CLEANED/SANITIZED ITEMS SHALL BE STORED UPSIDE DOWN. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed single service lids for bar drinks found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH MANAGEMENT TO TURN THE LIDS UPSIDE DOWN AT THE BAR AREA OF THE KITCHEN SPACE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Observed unwrapped coffee filters observed stored unprotected at the server station.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT THAT IF THE COFFEE FILTERS ARE REMOVED FROM THEIR ORIGINAL PACKAGING, TO KEEP THEM STORED IN A COVERED CONTAINER. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: 1) CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES IN THE MAIN COOK LINE AREA ABOVE THE 2DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REMOVE THE CARDBOARD AS IT IS NOT WASHABLE, DURABLE, OR NON-ABSORBENT. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) BEVERAGE AIR 1DOOR UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATOR AT THE BAR AREA OF THE KITCHEN OBSERVED AND MEASURED AT 45F, 2) 4DRAWER REFRIGERATOR LOCATED UNDER THE GRILL AT THE MAIN COOK LINE OBSERVED AND MEASURED AT 44F-46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO CALL FOR SERVICE FROM A LICENSED TECHNICIAN ON THE REFRIGERATORS AS NEEDED TO ENSURE FOOD REMAINS AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. AS A REMINDER, REFRIGERATION UNITS OPERATE BEST AT 34F-38F TO KEEP FOODS COLD AS REQUIRED AND WILL GO ON DEFROST CYCLES INTERMITTENTLY. EHS COMMUNICATED TO STAFF TO MOVE FOODS FROM THESE TWO UNITS INTO WORKING REFRIGERATORS IMMEDIATELY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the pre-scrape basin before the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH MANAGEMENT TO PUT IN A WORK ORDER TO OBTAIN A SHORTER HOSE AND NEW SPRING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. IN THE MEANTIME, STAFF SHALL HANG THE HOSE IN A WAY SO THAT IT DOES NOT FALL BELOW THE FLOOD LEVEL RIM.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed at the floor funnel located under the middle basin of the 3-vat sink not draining.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO UNCLOG THE LINE IMMEDIATELY. OWNER WAS ABLE TO UNCLOG THE LINE DURING THE INSPECTION. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps/holes in ceiling panels where soda lines, plumbing, electrical wiring or conduit lines are located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH STAFF TO SEAL THE GAPS USING A FOAMING CAULK TO SEAL UP THE GAPS AND PREVENT POSSIBLE INSECT/RODENT ENTRY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed the server station and both restroom ceiling panels not ceiling is not designed to be smooth and easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS COMMUNICATED WITH OWNERSHIP THAT THE CEILING PANELS IN THE SERVER STATION AND RESTROOMS SHALL BE EASILY CLEANABLE, NON- ABSORBENT, AND WASHABLE. REPLACE PANELS AS NEEDED WHEN THEY BECOME CRACKED, DAMAGED, OR WATER LEAKS OCCUR WITH VINYL COATED PANELING.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: BBQ pork, Pulled chicken, bacon, burrito beef/pork, all observed inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The identified foods were properly dated marked during the inspection.
